category_edits.rationale: Multiply the configured learning rate by 0.75 for all four category models to test whether smaller updates improve validation stability. Preserve optimizer, scheduler policy, batch size, dropout, weight decay, architecture, loss, seeds and stopping rules.

change_summary: Scale the learning rate by 0.75, changing the default from 0.001 to 0.00075 across all four categories. No predictor changes are required.
